title: Multi-Form, Transformation, Lifecycle & Appearance-State Management
objective: Support one governed entity across owner-approved Forms, lifecycle stages, disguises/presentation identities and temporary appearance states, including inheritance, stale-derivative behavior and comparison/transition previews without replacing the owning Form/state machine.

scope.purpose: Adapt MCCS presentation authoring across owner-approved Forms, lifecycle/stage contexts, disguises/presentation identities and temporary appearance states while keeping canonical Form/state transitions external.
scope.completion_gate: Representative entities with multiple owner-approved Forms/stages/presentation states can produce deterministic appearance-state plans, inheritance/staleness receipts and comparison/transition previews without mutating or replacing canonical Form/state-machine truth.

selection_boundaries: MCCS-01, MCCS-03, MCCS-05, MCCS-06, MCCS-09, MCCS-11, MCCS-13 and MCCS-16 are completed_verified foundations and are not reopened.
Fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.4 contains no MCCS-16-triggered rotation or interstitial override; reduced MCCS strict order therefore selects MCCS-18.
Character/NPC/Creature plus Species/Form/PPIA owners retain canonical Form, lifecycle, state, mechanics and live entity truth.
MCCS-18 may bind appearance projections to owner-approved Form/stage/state references and preview transitions, but may not create or advance the owning Form/state machine.
Disguises/presentation identities remain appearance-domain projections unless an owning identity/state contract explicitly accepts them.
Inheritance and stale-derivative behavior must be explicit and deterministic; unsupported/unresolved mappings may not be fabricated.
MCCS-18 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or authority exists until a later owner Continue.
ui-implementation and player-species remain independently governed and must be preserved exactly from fresh CURRENT.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue in product-development. On that command, govern-start MCCS-18 through the OPS3 protected-main FIFO; do not implement while selected_not_started.

stop_reason.evidence: MCCS-16 product proof completed; fresh DAG and reduced MCCS order select MCCS-18.
